contract: GET /api/search/podcast answers 401 without a token, 400 when term is absent or repeated as an array, and 200 with a null body when term is empty (with an optional country), without contacting iTunes. A non-empty term searches the fixed external iTunes host.
exceptions: normal is not applicable: the non-empty-term success path calls the fixed external host itunes.apple.com, so only the offline auth, validation and empty-term paths are asserted.

Unexecuted here: the built-in provider success paths (google, itunes, openlibrary, fantlab, audiobookcovers, audible) call fixed external hosts, so their result parsing and fuzzy fallback are not asserted by this packet; every deterministic offline path is asserted.

invariants.contract: GET /api/search/podcast answers 401 without a token, 400 when term is absent or an array, and 200 with a null body for term= plus an optional country parameter, calling neither iTunes nor any other provider.
